author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This gentleman had a wonderful dream.
context_before: the form of a dove descends, and – clothing you with Himself – once more sends you back into this world, to tell your story to those who will listen.
context_after: He may some day devise a plan that Western Airlines will use to ease the boarding congestion, but that was not the message of the dream. He is departing this world of Caesar. Having already had these experiences, he has forgotten them. But he will remember and know that when the time comes for him to depart this little section of time, he will not be restored to life, but will enter the New Age. Being one with the body of God he will know no restrictions, only the complete freedom of being God the Father.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Christmas-Man’S Birth As God (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: And from then on you will grow in stature.
context_before: When God is born in you it will be in the city of David. At that moment you are born as God.
context_after: You will grow in favor of the Father because you will know yourself to be one with him. You will continue to remain incarnate, however, until that moment when you express your last breath. Then you will discover yourself to be life itself, for you will have entered the one body, one Spirit, one Lord, one God and Father of all.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Christmas-Man’S Birth As God (1968-01-01).

quote_original: When the feeling leaves, where does it go?
context_before: Leprosy doesn’t come from without. Cancer doesn’t either. Everything is within man. Read the paper and react. That reaction sets a feeling in motion, be it anger, frustration, or irritation.
context_after: Back to sleep within you, for you contain the world and all that is in it.
